topology_contract: Dedicated client/daemon loopback fixture and same-host stateless forwarding relay. Pin OS/build/CPU/tool identity, network configuration and relay binary. No external Internet. Qualify each topology separately; do not pool them.
backoff_contract: Before every paired block establish the same key/role failure counter, escalation level, elapsed-time bucket and capacity state for all classes. Use isolated fixture resets or witnessed state transitions; never infer equal backoff from equal sleep. Preserve operational costs and report failed setup as failure.
stage_rule: From one client monotonic milestone record every external response, WSopcode/frame and closure through TCP/WSend. Pair all five failure classes within each topology/backoff stratum; do not condition away early rejections or compare only survivors. Any unsupported collection stage leaves gateFAIL.
sample_order: Balanced blocked permutation of five classes, seed frozen before launch, identical prescribed warmup; every attempt preserved, no retry/outlier deletion, timeouts areFAIL not missing data.

statistics.rationale: Distribution-wide equivalence margin onCDF, not failure to reject a zero difference. Under independent identically distributed observations within each class/stratum, DKW+union bound limits false equivalence acceptance across60pairs to0.01. With n=50000, null-distribution sampling allowances for both familyalpha0.01 and familybeta0.01 sum<0.05. Dependence or nonstationarity invalidates that calibration and leaves gateFAIL; this is a prospective design, no measured security result.

pin_exception: Only after cryptographic token proof verified and PINabsent; wrongPIN is ordinaryopaque rejection. Separateexception does not excuse invalid token/origin/proof/capability.
canonical_contract: Ordered server-to-peer frame projection plus actual rawlength and all deterministic fields, including unknown added fields, and exact close. Client stimulus is separately hashed; never erase a leaked reason. Preserve raw bytes in evidence. Authenticated encrypted frames require decrypted fields from the trusted peer collector, separatelybound to raw frames. HTTPresponse/EOFbeforeWS is explicitfailure until the same externallyobservable rejection contract is demonstrated.
crypto_contract: Base64url-no-pad canonical decoding and exact lengths; native crypto validators and per-exchange keygeneration/freshness attestation; no reused nonce, public ephemeral key or ML-KEMciphertext across trials. These values alone are excluded from rawequality, lengths retained. Client nonce/public/encapsulation material must independently satisfy protocol and distinct generation pertrial.

crypto_statistics.rule: Compare each decoded bit proportion acrossclasses with Hoeffding two-sample upperbound and Bonferroni overallbitspairs. Nonuniform constrained keybits are comparedbetweenclasses, not forceduniform. This finite projection is not a proof ofCSPRNGquality; native cryptographic/freshness checks remain mandatory.

native_evidence: NONE; synthetic positive/negative fixtures test the reference comparisons only.
